lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 1 of NBA season]: Reader is watching opening night unfold live. New today: LeBron's first game as a Sixer, the Core Four's debut together, and Philly ruining the Knicks' banner ceremony. Skip the 'historic Knicks title' setup — reader knows they won last year, saw the banner go up tonight. Lead with the spoiler: the 76ers walked into MSG on ring night and took the win. LeBron debut: 14-9-7 at 41 years old, most PTS/REB/AST by a 40+ year old in Sixers franchise history — historic in the quiet, workmanlike way. Maxey led with 28, took the most shots (19 FGA). Jaylen Brown: 19-8-6 in his Philly debut, solid but not dominant. Paul George: 38 points, league scoring leader on opening night, highest debut of his career. The Knicks' second half: Brunson disappeared (6 points on 2-10 shooting in second half). KAT in foul trouble. All the talk about the Sixers' starters, and the Knicks still led at one point — then Philly's depth took over. The ceremony itself: Mike Breen on the mic, the 1973 team handing out rings, Ewing and Starks in the stands smiling, the first banner in 53 years going up. Tracy Morgan drunk, calling out Bronny for no reason ('Bronny look like he got JUCO ball written all over him'). Josh Hart's hair braided to look like the Finals trophy. Reggie Miller sitting there watching the Knicks raise a banner — 'makes me somehow smile even bigger' per one Knicks fan. The game: disputed goaltending call, LeBron shoving Landry Shamet with no whistle, Drummond snatching the ball out of the air with the ref standing right there. LeBron yelling at a Knicks fan courtside: 'I'm not from the West Coast, I'm from Ohio baby.' Jaylen Brown still spraying on his hairline. The lob: Brown threw one to LeBron and immediately tried to recreate the LeBron-Wade photo — 'FIRST game with LeBron and he COULDN'T WAIT' per the internet. 'Every masterpiece has its cheap copy.' The Sixers are 1-0. The Knicks' title defense starts 0-1. The Core Four played their first regular-season game together, and the early returns: this group can win, and Maxey might be the engine. Prompt the writer: what does this game tell us about both teams? The Sixers have four All-Stars and zero excuses. The Knicks have a target on their back every single night now. How does this compare to other ring-night spoilers in NBA history (Lakers 2010, Raptors 2019)? What does LeBron's quiet, efficient debut say about how this team will use him?

Stephon Castle: 24 points for the Spurs. 'OKC/Spurs rivalry is beautiful for NBA fans' per O'Connor. This was a WCF rematch (Spurs won last year), and the Thunder made it clear they're coming for the crown. The rivalry: renewed, elevated, must-watch.
